A member of [[Darth Krayt]]'s [[One Sith]], this '''[[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]]''' was part of a [[First Sith Imperial Strikeforce|strikeforce]] that attacked [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Roan Fel]] during the execution of [[Operation: Thunderstroke]] on the planet [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]]. This Sith fought against [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Hira]], killing her with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]].<ref name="Legacy 2006 46">[[Legacy (2006) 46|''Legacy'' (2006) 46]]</ref>
